summary: Track 24.4 POST-DEPLOY LIVE PRODUCTION SMOKE TEST against https://mascidocs.com. Read-only browser probe of 14 surfaces. No submissions, no logins, no emails triggered. Overall verdict: NO P0 DEPLOYMENT BLOCKERS. Production is up, homepage loads in 0.14s, ZERO console errors/warnings across the entire test run, all 7 portal login pages return 200 with valid forms, all public surfaces render, mobile-390 has no horizontal overflow in EN or ES, autosave/draft persistence works via Restore/Discard prompt, and the 404 fallback is clean (no stack traces). Two honest findings: (P1) i18n coverage gap in DR V3 ES mode — several section-band headings and yes/no buttons remain English; (P2) testid drift between the review-request spec and shipped production DOM.

ui_bugs.issue: i18n coverage gap in ES mode — many strings do NOT translate when lang-es active: 'JOB SETUP', 'WAS THE JOB SAFE? · SAFETY / INCIDENTS / INSPECTIONS', 'ANY SAFETY INCIDENTS, INJURIES, ACCIDENTS, UTILITY HITS, NEAR MISSES, OR INSPECTIONS TODAY?', 'Answer the two questions below if Yes to any of the above.', 'WHO WAS THERE? · PEOPLE ON SITE', 'DID MASCI EMPLOYEES WORK ON SITE TODAY?', 'WERE SUBCONTRACTORS ON SITE TODAY?', 'WERE VISITORS OR INSPECTORS ON SITE TODAY?', 'EQUIPMENT & RESOURCES', 'WAS MASCI EQUIPMENT ON SITE OR USED TODAY?', 'WHAT MOVED? · MATERIALS / IMPORT / EXPORT', 'WERE MATERIALS DELIVERED OR IMPORTED TODAY?', 'WERE MATERIALS EXPORTED OR HAULED OFF TODAY?', 'WHAT GOT DONE? · WORK PERFORMED & PRODUCTION', 'WHAT IMPACTED TODAY? · DELAYS / CONSTRAINTS / EXTRA WORK', 'PHOTOS & ATTACHMENTS · REQUIRED EVIDENCE', 'WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? · TOMORROW / FOLLOW-UP', plus coaching-tip titles 'Why photos matter' and 'Common mistakes'.

Inconsistent yes/no localization in ES mode: excavation gate shows 'SÍ / NO' correctly, People-on-Site presence rows show 'Sí / No' correctly, BUT weather-impact / delays / accidents-on-site / injuries-reported buttons still render 'YES / NO' (English) when lang-es is active. Different button clusters use different translation dictionaries.

SPA catch-all returns HTTP 200 for unknown paths (e.g. /this-route-does-not-exist) while rendering a client-side '404 · PAGE NOT FOUND' UI. Visually clean and correct (no stack trace, Sign In + Public Home CTAs present), but search engines will index nonexistent URLs. Consider serving proper 404 status.

integration_issues.issue: Autosave persists correctly (verified across two page reloads — draft-restore banner reappears with Restore/Discard/BringItBack testids intact) BUT typed input value is NOT auto-populated on reload — user must click Restore. Not strictly a bug (by-design opt-in), but the review-request expected transparent restore of 'production-smoke-2026' into the Location input on reload; production behavior is Restore-prompt only.

issues: No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390 in both languages)
Sticky submit footer (ENVIAR / SUBMIT DAILY REPORT) renders correctly at 390 width
Signature canvas 'FIRMA DE PREPARADO POR' fits within viewport

action_items: P1 — Extend i18n dictionary in /app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.js to cover the ~17 English strings still leaking in ES mode on /daily/submit (band headings, section subheaders, safety/accidents/injuries questions, coaching-tip titles). Full list captured in ui_bugs above.

P1 — Localize the yes/no buttons that still read 'YES / NO' in ES mode: weather-impact-yes/no, schedule-delays-yes/no, safety-incidents-yes/no, injuries-reported-yes/no. Excavation and presence-crews already do it right — copy that pattern.

P2 — Reconcile testid drift: review-request references data-testid='dr-v3-lang-toggle', 'dr-v3-excavation-gate-yes', 'exc-cp-combo-filter' but production ships 'lang-toggle', 'exc-act-yes' / 'dr-excavation-activity-yes-panel' and NO 'exc-cp-combo-filter' (competent-person combo apparently lives on the linked excavation-record form, not the DR shell). Update the E2E playbook or add legacy testid aliases.
P3 — Consider real HTTP 404 status for unknown SPA routes (current: 200 with client-side 404 UI). SEO/monitoring benefit.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n gap suggests two parallel translation code paths (one used by excavation gate + presence rows, another used by weather/delays/safety/injuries) — consolidate on a single t() helper to avoid future drift.
Console is completely silent (0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 5xx across full test run) — solid production baseline.
Autosave restore prompt has excellent UX (Restore + Discard + Bring It Back testids all wired) — recovery UI is production-grade.
Portal login pages all healthy: 7/7 return 200 with email+password fields, all support EN/ES language toggle.

success_rate.frontend: 12/14 tests fully pass, 2 tests reveal P1 i18n gap; ZERO console errors; ZERO 5xx

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only smoke test, no writes attempted. Draft input 'production-smoke-2026' was typed for autosave probe only; the discard-draft button was clicked (production-safe operation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production DOM testid inventory captured — full 163-testid dump available in tool output. Key testids on /daily/submit: lang-en / lang-es / lang-toggle (NOT dr-v3-lang-toggle), exc-act-yes / exc-act-no / dr-excavation-activity-yes-panel (NOT dr-v3-excavation-gate-yes), input-location, input-project-name, submit-top-btn / submit-sticky-btn / submit-bottom-btn, daily-submit-photos-hint, daily-report-completeness-chip, daily-report-draft-restore-prompt-restore/-discard. The excavation section on the DR V3 shell only exposes 'Create new excavation record' and 'Link existing excavation record' after clicking exc-act-yes — the Competent Person combo, soil dropdown, protective systems and utilities fields are NOT on this page (they live on the linked excavation record). Production console is perfectly clean — treat any future console.error appearance as a real regression.

rca_of_findings.i18n_gap: Reproduction: (1) Navigate https://mascidocs.com/daily/submit, (2) click [data-testid='lang-es'], (3) scroll body — observe ~17 strings remain English while others translate correctly. Root cause hypothesis: strings hardcoded in JSX instead of routed through t()/translation-key lookup in /app/frontend/src/lib/i18n.js. Mitigation: audit NewDailyReportV3.jsx and child section components for literal English strings not wrapped in t().
rca_of_findings.testid_drift: Reproduction: search-request expects dr-v3-* testids; production ships legacy names. Mitigation: either regenerate the review-request testid list from live DOM or ship a compatibility layer that duplicates data-testid on the same element.
rca_of_findings.404_status_200: SPA hosted via static-first + client-router fallback returns 200 for unknown routes. Standard SPA pitfall; not a defect but worth noting.
